title: AWS Marketplace Registration Request
description: Anonymous landing-page POST from AWS Marketplace carrying the resolvable purchase token. The route reads the field from form data first (request.form), then falls back to a JSON body with the same field name -- AWS's real landing-page POST is application/x-www-form-urlencoded, but the handler also accepts application/json. See src/routes/marketplace_routes.py:register.

^x-amzn-marketplace-token$.description: AWS-issued marketplace registration token, resolved server-side via the AWS Marketplace Metering/Entitlement API (src/services/billing/aws_marketplace/client.py). Never logged or persisted; only its resolution result is used. Named via patternProperties rather than properties so this literal AWS field name (which happens to start with "x-") is not misread as a JSON-Schema/OpenAPI vendor-extension keyword by the repo's x-extension governance check; validation semantics are identical to a properties entry of the same name.
